title: Star Formation and Molecular Gas Diagnostics with Mid- and Far-infrared Emission
question: How do mid-infrared (MIR) spectral features from 5–35 μm and infrared photometry from 3.4–250 μm correlate with star formation rate (SFR) and molecular gas (CO)?

recipe.goal: Define overlapping IRS apertures and extract spectra and CO/IR photometry
recipe.method: Define 154 polygonal apertures from the spatial overlap of Spitzer-IRS SL, SH, and LH modules; convolve IRAC, WISE, MIPS, and PACS photometry to 15" FWHM to match the CO J=(2-1) maps; perform background subtraction outside R_25 with a 3σ mask; extract average IRS spectra, photometry, and CO J=(2-1) intensities and errors in the apertures; exclude AGN nuclei and regions lacking neon detections.
key_parameters: 15" FWHM Gaussian PSF; S/N > 3 for CO detections; 154 total apertures (112 SF regions, 67 with CO S/N > 3)
assumptions: Constant 10% uncertainty on measured surface brightness in each aperture for all photometric bands; no extended source or IRS aperture corrections applied

recipe.goal: Fit MIR spectral features in SL, SH, and LH spectra
recipe.method: Fit SL spectra using PAHFIT with no attenuation fitting. Fit SH spectra using custom FARAMIR routine (linear continuum subtraction between 10–15 μm and 15–18.2 μm, Drude profiles for PAHs including 4 Drude components for the 11.3 μm complex, and Gaussian profiles for lines). Fit LH spectra by cropping ±1 μm around H2 S(0), [S III] 33.5 μm, and [Si II] 34.8 μm, subtracting a linear continuum, and fitting Gaussians. Estimate SH and LH uncertainties with 500 Monte Carlo trials and apply a 3σ residual detection threshold.
key_parameters: 500 Monte Carlo trials; 3σ residual amplitude detection threshold; initial feature wavelengths and FWHMs in Table 2
assumptions: MIR dust attenuation is minimal and not fit in PAHFIT; linear dust continuum in SH and LH spectral windows

recipe.goal: Decompose IRAC4 8 μm and WISE3 12 μm bands via synthetic photometry
recipe.method: Stitch SL (5.2–14.7 μm) and continuum-adjusted SH (14.7–16.4 μm) spectra, decompose SL spectra into PAH, dust continuum, starlight, and line components using PAHFIT, and perform synthetic photometry to measure fractional contributions to IRAC4 8 μm and WISE3 12 μm.
key_parameters: 120 non-AGN spectra; SL 5.2–14.7 μm stitched with SH 14.7–16.4 μm
assumptions: Appended 14.7–16 μm SH spectral segment is treated as continuum

recipe.goal: Derive reference Σ_SFR and TIR and compute correlations with CO and Σ_SFR
recipe.method: Calculate TIR using Eq. (1) and reference Σ_SFR from [Ne II] 12.8 μm, [Ne III] 15.6 μm, and KK04 metallicity using Eq. (2). Compute Spearman rank correlation coefficients (ρ_s) and fit logarithmic power laws log10(Y) = m log10(X) + b via ordinary least squares with 500 Monte Carlo perturbation and bootstrap resampling trials.
key_parameters: 500 Monte Carlo + bootstrap trials; subsample split at physical area 0.4 kpc^2
assumptions: CO J=(2-1) surface brightness used directly as reference molecular gas tracer without applying a CO-to-H2 conversion factor
